NORMAL.condition: SHARP+AIA technically available and frozen multimodal trust gates pass.

DEGRADED.condition: NORMAL is false but SHARP remains technically available.
DEGRADED.action: Issue SHARP fallback and label forecast DEGRADED.

ABSTAIN.action: Withhold forecast. Automatic AIA-only fallback is not enabled.

outcome_visibility: issue time + 72 h horizon + 24 h reporting delay
